INSTALL NEW HEAVY DUTY DOOR CLOSER AND ADJUST THE DOOR TO MAKE IT SELF-CLOSING AND LATCHED PROPERLY . RETURN THE DOOR TO PROPER WORKING ORDER . ALL WORK MUST BE DONE AS PROPER WORKING ORDER. TOTAL JOB TO BE DONE = 01(ONE). Self-closing door hinges to be Installed as Per Local law 111 of 2018. Replace door hinges, located in vestibule, hallway, stairway or apartment entrance door by means of at least two self-closing, spring types hinges per door in conformity to NYC construction code. Hinges provided and installed shall be constructed of steel. Hinges shall be installed and adjusted in such a manner that door shall swing easily and freely and that positive latching is achieved when the door is allowed to close freely from an open position of 30 degrees. “REMOVE ALL WORK-RELATED DEBRIS.” ALL WORK MUST BE DONE AS PER HPD SPECIFICATIONS.
